question: Why did Joseph tell his family to say they were keepers of livestock when they met Pharaoh?
options: So they could settle in Goshen, since shepherds were detestable to the Egyptians
So Pharaoh would give them gold
So they could work in the palace
explanation: Joseph advised them to say they raised livestock so they would be allowed to settle in Goshen, since shepherds were detestable to the Egyptians.
